name: LimX Oli
summary: LimX Dynamics' full-size general-purpose humanoid, positioned above CL-1 as a development platform for embodied-AI research and light industrial tasks, with the company's own actuators and a tiered set of hand and compute options.
notable: LimX's full-size platform for embodied-AI developers

sources.title: LimX Dynamics launches LimX Oli full-size humanoid — The Robot Report
